# PizzaCrave

> PizzaCrave is an artisan Italian wood-fired pizza kitchen and online delivery platform serving handcrafted sourdough pizzas baked at 800°F with 30-minute hot delivery.

## Documentation & Menu

- [Artisan Pizza Menu](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/#menu): Complete list of artisan wood-fired pizzas, vegetarian specialties, and pricing.
- [Today's Special Deals](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/#deals): Limited-time daily promotions, family bundles, and combo discounts.
- [Custom Pizza Studio](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/#customizer): Interactive custom pizza builder allowing customers to choose crusts, sauces, cheeses, and toppings with live pricing.
- [Our Pizzeria Story](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/#about): Information about sourdough fermentation, imported San Marzano tomatoes, and wood-fired hearth baking.
- [Delivery Policy & Coverage](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/#delivery): 30-minute doorstep delivery guarantee and temperature-controlled insulated packaging.

## Business Details

- [Store Location](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/#contact): 24 Italian Piazza, Little Italy, NY 10013.
- [Telephone Orders](tel:+18007499227): Customer service and order inquiry hotline at +1 (800) 749-9227.
- [Email Support](mailto:hello@pizzacrave.com): General inquiries and business correspondence.
- [API Health Status](https://pizzacraveserver.vercel.app/api/health): Live operational status of the PizzaCrave backend and database cluster.

## Optional

- [Customer Authentication](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/login): Customer account sign-in with email/password and Google Single Sign-On.
- [Customer Account Registration](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/register): Create a new customer profile to save delivery addresses and favorite orders.
- [Customer Dashboard](https://pizzacravehub.vercel.app/dashboard): Active order tracking pipeline with real-time status updates and order history.
